title: MSA & APWA "Roadeo"
notes: MSA = Maintenance Supervisors Association.  APWA = American Public Works Association.  I'd done a presentation for them before and they asked me to come to this event.  Was told to bring a pop-up and and table, swag, etc.  But when I got there they were like, "You're tabling?  Ummmm... I guess you could go over here?" (my "host"/contact was elsewhere when I go there). Turned out great, was able to get ITC hooked up with someone from Placer County, and had some great discussions with people, and a couple people interested in presentations at their yards.  Nathan was effusively grateful that I came and apologetic for the day being a bit confusing, etc.  But you go with the flow and it all worked out.

title: APWA & MSA "Roadeo"
notes: I was asked by my "host" to do two presentations. One at around 8:00 am another for a second group in the 9:15/9:30. Not a set-in-stone schedj, but the idea was to do them before lunch, rotating groups throughout the "Roadeo." I was told I was going to be under some kind of shell (I was imagining some kind of park venue, open-but-under-a-roof type of gazebo/structure) and that A/V would be handled.  It was just a pop-up with the a screen that kept being blown down by the wind, with the sun shining through it. My morning sesh was announced out loud, but no one had actually scheduled or told their guys they had to go down to my training, they were all focused on the Roadeo. Two higher-up people from City of Roseville came to the presentation and we looked at a few slides and talked about some new changes, tolerance zone issues, and they shared some stories.  Great conversations though. Talked about complacency as an issue.  There was no second session as it got moved to after lunch, but then they did a giant raffle after lunch and attendees were ready to go home.
